scope: Round 03 passes as a candidate review surface. The social-caption hierarchy remains an agent recommendation; this record does not promote CMP-06 or close Olli's human gate.

hierarchy.reason: The revised profile stack reads Name, Username and Followers before a broad quote, while the live portrait remains a distinct supporting proof object.

composition.reason: The desktop rail is wide and shallow without a chassis. At compact widths the 96px portrait and identity form one top band and the quote spans the complete row beneath, removing the prior empty column.

pacing.reason: A 24px/s drift, phase-level pauses and generous homepage separation create a measured proof beat. Five stacked rails remain workbench-only.

typography.reason: Display, quote, name, username and follower roles are clear with no decorative type layer. Long real quotes remain readable at every declared width.

productTruth.reason: Seven real clips, quotes and curated profile images are local and Daniel remains honestly excluded. Follower figures are dated snapshots and two retain source-project attribution, so this cannot score 5.

distinctiveness.reason: Live halftone people plus recognisable but non-clickable Instagram profile evidence create a Mez proof rail that remains distinctive without gradient, glass or card theatre.

narrative.reason: The workbench moves from five hierarchy comparisons into live measurement and an explicit human gate; the homepage gives proof a clear pause after the hero.

conversionClarity.reason: CMP-06 intentionally has no CTA. Removing carousel and social-link chrome prevents false destinations while the focusable phase remains operable.

emotionalResonance.reason: Moving real faces, familiar profile images and first-person language add human warmth without manufactured testimonial ornament.

craft.reason: Local asset resolution, one semantic list, hidden loop copy, passive native input, 907ms measured recovery, complete keyboard path, static reduced motion and offscreen idling resolve together.

originality.reason: The surface borrows Instagram's evidence order without cloning its frame and rejects the standard boxed testimonial carousel.

T1StripTest.method: Desktop and compact renders were inspected without relying on colour or portrait motion.
T1StripTest.evidence: Hierarchy survives through scale, open composition, source order, one structural rule and Mez typography; no gradient, glow, texture or profile-card shell carries the design.

T2ComponentRepetitionTest.method: All five 1440px presentation families and their shared 320px convergence were inspected in adjacent context.
T2ComponentRepetitionTest.evidence: Profile strip, portrait window, social caption, quote first and proof ledger change reading order and proportional logic. The component adds no repeated button or card cluster.

T3MotionComparisonTest.method: The proof-ledger rail and visible portrait videos were sampled 1,250ms apart; direct-input recovery, focused hold and offscreen instances were measured separately.
T3MotionComparisonTest.evidence: The rail advanced 31px in 1.25s; both visible videos advanced 1.273s; no clipped portrait remained live. Manual scroll recovered in 907ms and focused drift changed by 0px over 600ms.

T4RealContentTest.method: Every declared viewport used the seven-record fixture, seven local prepared clips and seven cropped curated Mez profile images.
T4RealContentTest.evidence: Every width rendered 7 primary and 7 hidden-loop items in moving mode, no Daniel record, no outbound link, no placeholder and no missing local media.

canonScan.notes: No mesh gradient, indigo-violet palette, glass, ambient shadow, backdrop blur, generic card grid, pill cluster or decorative filler appears. Continuous carousel drift remains a deliberate bounded exception to DEC-WEBSITE-MOTION-SYSTEM-001, revised by Olli in round-03-feedback.json to use phase-level and direct-input safeguards without visible controls.

findings.finding: The previous two-column mobile structure left blank space beneath the portrait.
findings.resolution: The portrait and profile now share the first row and the quote spans both columns beneath.

findings.finding: The horizontal account row scattered identity facts and omitted the existing curated profile image.
findings.resolution: Every item now renders the local profile image and a Name, Username, Followers stack with the full name allowed to wrap on compact widths.

findings.finding: The initial 190px evidence column truncated Kayvon's name after adding the profile image.
findings.resolution: The evidence column increased to 240px while preserving a wide quote measure.

findings.finding: The continuous drift exception is explicit but now has no persistent visible stop control at Olli's direction.
findings.resolution: Keep the component candidate-only until Olli approves or revises this final safeguard posture.

humanGate.question: Approve, revise or reject the Round 03 social-caption recommendation and its control-free bounded auto-scroll exception.
